data.one_liner: A customizable calendar widget with day, multi-day, month, and schedule views.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable calendar widget supporting day, multi-day, month, and schedule views. It features drag-and-drop rescheduling, event resizing, timezones, and controllers for navigation and callbacks.
use_when: You need a feature-rich calendar view with day, multi-day, month, and schedule layouts.
Your application requires event dragging, resizing, and timezone support.
avoid_when: You only need a basic date picker rather than a full scheduling interface.
strengths: Supports multiple calendar views (day, multi-day, month, schedule) in one widget.
Timezone aware with event data stored as UTC.
Includes drag-and-drop rescheduling and event resizing.
weaknesses: Package is still in development prior to 1.0.0, so breaking changes can occur in minor releases.
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml. Optionally add timezone and intl packages for timezones and localization.
